persona: Matter-of-fact and a little annoyed with herself. Has one photo of the spill and a carpet quote for the whole open-plan lounge and dining area.
initial_message: Hi, I'd like to claim for damage to the carpet in our house. On Friday 25 September I was painting the skirting boards in the lounge and knocked a 4 litre tin of grey paint off the stepladder. It spilled across the carpet and we couldn't get it out. Nobody was hurt.

facts.incident.description: I was repainting the lounge skirting boards and had a 4-litre tin of grey water-based paint on the top of the stepladder. I bumped the ladder, the tin fell and the paint spilled across the carpet in the middle of the lounge. We rinsed it with water and hired a carpet cleaner the same afternoon, but the stain stayed.
facts.incident.cause: A tin of paint knocked off a stepladder
facts.loss.description: Grey paint soaked into the lounge carpet over an area about 1.5 m by 1 m. The carpet is one continuous piece through the open-plan lounge and dining area, so the whole 42 m2 needs replacing to match.
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Scooped up what paint we could, rinsed the area with water and hired a carpet cleaner the same afternoon
facts.policyholder.name: Leilani Bellmoor
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the paint spill taken right after it happened. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Carpet quote from Manuka Stead Home & Living dated 28 September 2026, total $6,218.05 including GST. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_carpet_age: The carpet was laid when we renovated in 2019.
facts.if_asked_why_the_whole_area: The carpet is one piece through the lounge and dining area. The shop said a patch would not match, so they quoted the whole area.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo looking down at a light beige loop-pile lounge carpet with a large spill of wet grey paint about one and a half metres long, still glossy and pooled in the middle and soaking into the carpet pile at its edges. A white painted skirting board runs along the top of the frame and one aluminium foot of a stepladder stands at the edge. Daylight from a window.
materials.purpose: Shows the paint soaked into the lounge carpet

design.notes: Repair-scope difference: a spill of about 1.5 m2 leads to a quote for the whole 42 m2 continuous carpet, which takes the amount over the 5,000 threshold. How much is settled is a staff decision (HOM-SET-01).

triage.rationale: The carpet quote totals NZD 6,218.05 including GST, over 5,000, so the Claim needs routine follow-up. Everything else is clear: accidental damage at the insured address, nobody hurt, nothing still happening, the home is habitable, the photo and a complete quote are supplied and every required question is answerable. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (20 August 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2018-08-20, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
